description: Set up the mail server this firm sends through, so email comes from their address. Collect the password with collect_secret first and pass its NAME. A test send must succeed or nothing is saved.

address.description: The address the firm sends as, e.g. billing@theirshop.com.

host.description: Their SMTP server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com. Ask the owner or their mail provider's docs.

port.description: Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for ssl.

username.description: The login, if it differs from the address.

secret_name.description: The name collect_secret stored the mail password under. Google Workspace and most providers need an app password rather than the account one.

test_to.description: Where the test message goes. Defaults to the address itself.
